name: Soppo

skills.name: Hunting Fang
skills.description:
Deals Freeze damage equal to 80% of attack to the target. Soppo gains Confectance Index and 2 points of Hunting Mark, which is her personal mark. If Soppo is in Mad Dog Mode, this skill instead deals Burn damage.

[Mad Dog Mode]: In this state, certain skills deal Burn damage. Can switch to [Hunting Hound Mode].
[Hunting Hound Mode]: In this state, certain skills deal Freeze damage. Can switch to [Mad Dog Mode].

skills.name: Vicious Bite
skills.description:
Deals AoE Freeze damage equal to 80% of attack to the target and all enemy targets within a 3-tile radius around it, generating Frost tiles for 2 turns. After this skill, Soppo performs the basic attack Hunting Fang on the nearest enemy target within 8 tiles and gains Extra Command.

If Soppo is in Mad Dog Mode, this skill instead deals AoE Burn damage and generates Incineration tiles. Soppo does not gain Extra Command.

skills.name: Lunar Howl
skills.description:
Lands on the selected empty Freeze or Burn tile within the battlefield and applies Slaughtertrail to all nearby allied Dolls within an 8-tile radius (excluding Soppo herself) for 3 turns, allowing them to generate Frost tiles around the target after performing an active attack; and damage dealt to enemy units on phase tiles is increased. After this skill, Soppo switches to Mad Dog Mode.

If Soppo is in Mad Dog Mode, instead deals AoE Burn damage equal to 120% of attack to all enemy targets nearby within a 4-tile radius. This damage is shared evenly among all targets within the effective area. After this skill, Soppo performs the basic attack Hunting Fang on the nearest enemy target within 8 tiles and gains Extra Action.

skills.name: Fatal Pounce
skills.description:
Selects all enemy targets within a 6-tile radius, expends all stacks of Hunting Mark, and deals AoE Freeze damage equal to number of Hunting Mark stacks × 30% of attack. If this attack hits enemy targets on phase tiles, additionally deals Freeze damage equal to 50% of attack to them. After this skill, Soppo switches to Hunting Hound Mode.

Passive: Before nearby enemy units within 8 tiles launch an active attack, performs Interception on them, dealing Freeze damage equal to 30% of attack and 4 points of stability damage. Can trigger at most once per turn.

skills.name: Vampup Syndrome
skills.description:
At the start of the battle, Soppo begins in Hunting Hound Mode and expends Confectance Index (consumes 3 points of own Confectance Index) to gain a Frost Barrier for 3 turns. Frost Barrier absorbs damage equal to 65% of initial attack, up to a maximum of 60% of max HP.

At the start of the battle, if there are 3 or more allied Burn attributed Dolls on the battlefield (excluding Soppo herself), then when she uses the basic attack Hunting Fang or the active skill Vicious Bite and is in Hunting Hound Mode, damage dealt to enemy targets with Burn debuffs is increased by 100%. If there are 3 or more allied Freeze attributed Dolls on the battlefield (excluding Soppo herself), then when she uses the abovementioned skills or the active skill Lunar Howl and is in Mad Dog Mode, damage dealt to enemy targets with Freeze debuffs is increased by 100%. If neither condition is met, Soppo gains 2 stacks of Permanent Hunting Mark.

After performing an active attack, Soppo gains Rabid Factor, increasing her critical damage dealt (up to a maximum of 10 stacks). When she has 4 stacks of Rabid Factor, she gains Rabid Factor I. When she has 6 stacks of Rabid Factor, she gains Rabid Factor II. When she has 8 or more stacks of Rabid Factor, she gains Rabid Factor III.

[Rabid Factor I]: When attacking an enemy target on a phase tile with active attacks, ignores 10% of the target's defense. For each level of the tile, ignores an additional 10% of the target's defense.
[Rabid Factor II]: For each Freeze or Burn buff on Soppo, Freeze and Burn damage dealt is increased by 5%.
[Rabid Factor III]: Before dealing damage, generates Frost tiles around the target. If Soppo is in Mad Dog Mode, instead generates Incineration tiles. Damage dealt to enemy targets on phase tiles is increased by 15%. For each level of the tile, damage dealt is further increased by 10%.

fortification.effect:
The damage multiplier is increased to 130%.
If in Hunting Hound Mode, gains 2 stacks of Hunting Mark after attacking, and gains Extra Action instead of Extra Command.

After moving onto the target tile, if that tile is a Freeze or Burn tile, deals Freeze damage or Burn damage equal to 80% of attack to the 3 nearest enemy targets within 8 tiles.
If that tile is an Ashen (Freeze-Burn) tile, instead deals 1 instance of Freeze damage and 1 instance of Burn damage, each equal to 80% of attack, to the 3 nearest enemy targets within 8 tiles.
If in Mad Dog Mode, gains 1 stack of Hunting Mark after skill usage.

The effect of Slaughtertrail is enhanced: the range for creating Frost tiles is increased by 2 tiles; before performing an active attack, Soppo gains 1 stack of Rabid Factor.
If in Mad Dog Mode, the damage multiplier is increased to 150%. If the enemy target is standing on a Level 1 tile, the damage is increased by 10%; for every 1 tile level, the damage is further increased by 10%.

The damage increase from team conditions against enemy targets is raised to 150% and no longer requires the target to have any debuffs. The number of Permanent Hunting Mark stacks gained is increased by 2.

The multiplier is increased to number of Hunting Mark stacks × 50% of attack. When using this skill, consumes all Confectance Index; for each additional 1 point of Confectance Index consumed, the base multiplier is increased by 5%. After skill usage, restores 2 points of Confectance Index.
After triggering Interception, gains 2 stacks of Hunting Mark. The damage multiplier of Interception is increased to 60%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - This Is My Turf
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, gains Rabid Factor.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Beware of Sopdog
keys.effect: After attacking enemy targets on phase tiles, cleanses a buff from them.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Cocytus
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, Soppo generates [Frost] tiles around of herself.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Licking Wounds
keys.effect: If Soppo takes damage while she is on a phase tile, damage and stability damage taken is reduced.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Unfettered Bloodlust
keys.effect: When Soppo has a shield, Freeze damage and Burn damage dealt is increased.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Group Coordination
keys.effect: After an allied unit (excluding Soppo herself) performs an out-of-turn attack, Soppo gains any missing effects among [Blazing Assault I] and [Boreal Assault].

keys.name: Common Key - Call of the Wild
keys.effect: When attacking an enemy unit on a Freeze or Burn tile, phase damage dealt is increased.
